svg.title: One MM update separates data pull, repulsion, and movement
svg.desc: Three panels repeat the same four-row scene. The first forms an inverse-distance weighted mean, the second adds equal-length unit repulsions away from two other support points, and the third moves the focal support point to their computed sum inside the data bounding box.
